Total damage on ARMOR alone: 346 fabricated beads, ~2,300 combined bead-cycles across two workers, while 5 real, actually-dispatched beads sat untouched the entire time. A parallel instance of the same pattern was found mid-execution on `~/SIGIL` (worker `echo`), not yet cleaned up.\n14\t\n15\t**Bug 2 — fleet process tracking has blind spots.** Remediating the above required stopping the runaway workers, which surfaced a second, independent defect:\n16\t- `needle stop -i <session>` reported success and removed the session from `needle list`, but the underlying OS process (the actual `needle run --workspace ...` process and its dispatched `claude` subprocess) kept running and kept dispatching against the target repo. It had to be killed directly by PID (`kill -9`) after cross-referencing `ps aux`.\n17\t- A third worker (`alpha`, also pointed at ARMOR, also actively dispatching) was running the entire time and was **completely invisible to both `needle status` and `needle list`** — discovered only via `ps aux | grep 'needle run'`.\n18\t\n19\tBoth bugs share a root theme: NEEDLE's own operational state (what it's confused about, what it's running) leaks into or is undiscoverable from the wrong place — the target repo's bead tracker in Bug 1, nowhere-queryable in Bug 2.\n20\t\n21\t## Decision\n22\t\n23\t1. **Redirect Pluck's starvation self-diagnostic to NEEDLE's own telemetry.** Never write it as a bead into the scanned workspace. Emit a structured `pluck.starvation_detected` telemetry event (workspace, open count, excluded count, candidate reasons) through the existing telemetry pipeline (the same one `ExploreStrand`'s Phase-5 starvation alarm uses — see ADR-001 §5.4). If a persistent, actionable record is wanted, file it as a bead in **NEEDLE's own** workspace, never the target's.\n24\t2. **Treat \"Pluck configuration is unreachable from a target-scoped worker\" as a structural constraint, not a solvable task.** A target-repo worker must never be prompted to investigate or fix NEEDLE's own dispatch configuration — that class of work has no legitimate resolution path from inside the target repo and should be filtered out of what gets auto-decomposed there.\n25\t3. **`needle stop` must kill the full process tree**, not just detach/remove the tmux registry entry: parent `needle run` process, its `bash -c` prompt wrapper, and the dispatched `claude` subprocess. Verify the PID is actually gone before reporting success, not just that the tmux session no longer lists it.\n26\t4. **`needle status`/`needle list` must not have registry blind spots.** Every `needle run` process, however it was started (tmux-wrapped, bare `NEEDLE_INNER=1` background, etc.), must be discoverable through standard fleet commands. Reconcile the process-table view (`ps aux`) against the registry view as a health check, and WARN on any process matching `needle run --workspace` that isn't in the registry.\n27\t\n28\t## Consequences\n29\t\n30\t- Pluck's starvation signal becomes debuggable (NEEDLE operator telemetry) instead of destructively actionable (a bead a worker will try, and fail, to resolve).\n31\t- Removes the specific self-perpetuating loop that produced this incident; ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n413\t\n414\t/// `needle run` — launch a worker.\n415\t///\n416\t/// Always creates dedicated tmux sessions for workers,   // load state from heartbeat file + registry, continue from SELECTING.\n457\t        let worker_id = identifier\n458\t            .clone()\n459\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n460\t\n461\t        // Load resume state from heartbeat and registry.\n462\t        let resume_state = crate::upgrade::ResumeState::load(&config, sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n509\t        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant invocation)\");\n510\t        run_worker(config, worker_id)\n511\t    } else {\n512\t        // Always create dedicated tmux sessions, even if already inside tmux.\n513\t        launch_workers(\n514\t            config, workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, hot_reload,\n515\t        )\n516\t    }\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t/// Launch `count` workers in separate tmux sessions with staggered startup delays.\n520\tpub fn launch_workers(\n521\t    config: Config,\n522\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n523\t    agent: Option<String>,\n524\t    count: u32,\n525\t    identifier: alphabet\");\n565\t    }\n566\t\n567\t    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n568\t    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n569\t    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n570\t NATO_ALPHABET {\n601\t            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n602\t                break;\n603\t            }\n604\t            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n605\t                tracing::warn!(\n606\t                    worker_id = %name,\n607\t                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n608\t                );\n609\t                continue;\n610\t state machine (called when inside tmux or for direct mode).\n802\t///\n803\t/// Creates telemetry and the tokio runtime *before* any other initialization\n804\t/// so that `worker.booting` is the very first JSONL event. Each subsequent\n805\t/// init step is wrapped with `init.step.started` / `init.step.completed` so a\n806\t/// silent hang pinpoints the exact blocking call.\n807\tfn run_worker(config: Config, worker_name: String) -> Result<()> {\n808\t    let boot_start = Instant::now();\n809\t    let qualified_id = format!(\"{}-{}\", config.agent.default, worker_name);\n810\t\n811\t    // Phase 0: create tokio runtime + telemetry, emit worker.booting immediately.\n812\t    // Emit eprintln diagnostics before each step so hangs are visible even if telemetry fails.\n813\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker %result, \"worker finished\");\n882\t    Ok(())\n883\t}\n884\t\n885\t/// Emit start/complete telemetry around a fallible initialization step.\n886\t///\n887\t/// Each step's completion is force-flushed to disk so that if a subsequent\n888\t/// step blocks indefinitely, the telemetry log shows exactly where it stopped.\n889\t/// Also emits eprintln diagnostics for visibility even if telemetry hangs.\n890\tfn init_step<T, F>(name: &str, tel: &Telemetry, f: F) -> Result<T>\n891\twhere\n892\t    F: FnOnce() -> Result<T>,\n893\t{\n894\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting tel.force_flush(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1))?;\n908\t    result\n909\t}\n910\t\n911\t/// Returns true when this process is a re-entrant inner invocation launched\n912\t/// by `launch_in_tmux()`, Option<String>,\n923\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n924\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n925\t) -> Result<()> {\n926\t    // Build the command that tmux will run inside the session.\n927\t    let self_exe ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n413\t\n414\t/// `needle run` — launch a worker.\n415\t///\n416\t/// Always creates dedicated tmux sessions for workers, even when invoked from\n417\t/// inside an existing tmux session. The only exception is a re-entrant inner\n418\t/// invocation launched by `launch_in_tmux()`, which is identified by the\n419\t/// `NEEDLE_INNER=1` environment variable and runs the worker directly.\n420\tfn cmd_run(\n421\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n422\t    agent: Option<String>,\n423\t    count: u32,\n424\t    identifier: Option<String>,\n425\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n426\t    resume: bool,\n427\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n428\t) -> Result<()> {\n429\t    // Determine workspace root (CLI arg → canonicalized, else global default).\n430\t    let workspace_root = if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n431\t        ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n432\t    } else {\n433\t        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n434\t        global.workspace.default.clone()\n435\t    };\n436\t\n437\t    // Load full resolved config (global → workspace .needle.yaml → env → CLI).\n438\t    let cli_overrides = CliOverrides {\n439\t        workspace: Some(workspace_root.clone()),\n440\t        agent_binary: agent.clone(),\n441\t        max_workers: None,\n442\t        ..Default::default()\n443\t    };\n444\t    let (mut config, _) = ConfigLoader::load_resolved(&workspace_root, cli_overrides)?;\n445\t\n446\t    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n447\t        config.agent.timeout = t;\n448\t    }\n449\t\n450\t    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n451\t        config.self_modification.hot_reload = hr;\n452\t    }\n453\t\n454\t    if resume {\n455\t        // Hot-reload resume: inherit worker identity from --identifier,\n456\t        // load state from heartbeat file + registry, continue from SELECTING.\n457\t        let worker_id = identifier\n458\t            .clone()\n459\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n460\t\n461\t        // Load resume state from heartbeat and registry.\n462\t        let resume_state = crate::upgrade::ResumeState::load(&config, &worker_id)?;\n463\t\n464\t        // Emit upgrade.completed telemetry.\n465\t        let current_hash = crate::upgrade::file_hash(\n466\t            &std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?,\n467\t        )\n468\t        .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n469\t\n470\t        match &resume_state {\n471\t            Some(state) => {\n472\t                tracing::info!(\n473\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n474\t                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n475\t                    beads_processed = state.beads_processed,\n476\t                    session = %state.session,\n477\t                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload\"\n478\t                );\n479\t            }\n480\t            None => {\n481\t                tracing::info!(\n482\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n483\t                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n484\t                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload (no prior state found)\"\n485\t                );\n486\t            }\n487\t        }\n488\t\n489\t        let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(worker_id.clone(), &config.telemetry)\n490\t            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n491\t                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n492\t                crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(worker_id.clone())\n493\t            });\n494\t        tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::UpgradeCompleted {\n495\t            new_hash: current_hash,\n496\t        })?;\n497\t\n498\t        return run_worker(config, worker_id);\n499\t    }\n500\t\n501\t    if is_needle_inner() {\n502\t        // Re-entrant inner invocation launched by launch_in_tmux() — run\n503\t        // the worker directly inside the dedicated session already created.\n504\t        let worker_id = identifier\n505\t            .clone()\n506\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n507\t        let agent_name = agent.as_deref().unwrap_or(&config.agent.default);\n508\t        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n509\t        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant invocation)\");\n510\t        run_worker(config, worker_id)\n511\t    } else {\n512\t        // Always create dedicated tmux sessions, even if already inside tmux.\n513\t        launch_workers(\n514\t            config, workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, hot_reload,\n515\t        )\n516\t    }\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t/// Launch `count` workers in separate tmux sessions with staggered startup delays.\n520\tpub fn launch_workers(\n521\t    config: Config,\n522\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n523\t    agent: Option<String>,\n524\t    count: u32,\n525\t    identifier: Option<String>,\n526\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n527\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n528\t) -> Result<()> {\n529\t    let agent_name = agent\n530\t        .as_deref()\n531\t        .unwrap_or(&config.agent.default)\n532\t        .to_string();\n533\t    let stagger_secs = config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds;\n534\t    let max_workers = config.worker.max_workers;\n535\t\n536\t    if count == 0 {\n537\t        bail!(\"--count must be at least 1\");\n538\t    }\n539\t    if count as usize > NATO_ALPHABET.len() {\n540\t        bail!(\n541\t            \"--count {} exceeds the maximum of {} (NATO alphabet size)\",\n542\t            count,\n543\t            NATO_ALPHABET.len()\n544\t        );\n545\t    }\n546\t\n547\t    // Enforce max_workers cap (0 means unlimited).\n548\t    let effective_count = if max_workers > 0 && count > max_workers {\n549\t        tracing::warn!(\n550\t            requested = count,\n551\t            capped_to = max_workers,\n552\t            \"count exceeds max_workers; capping\"\n553\t        );\n554\t        eprintln!(\n555\t            \"Warning: --count {count} exceeds max_workers={max_workers}; launching {max_workers} workers\"\n556\t        );\n557\t        max_workers\n558\t    } else {\n559\t        count\n560\t    };\n561\t\n562\t    // --identifier is only meaningful for a single worker.\n563\t    if effective_count > 1 && identifier.is_some() {\n564\t        bail!(\"--identifier cannot be combined with --count > 1; identifiers are auto-assigned from the NATO alphabet\");\n565\t    }\n566\t\n567\t    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n568\t    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n569\t    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n570\t        tracing::info!(\n571\t            occupied = ?occupied,\n572\t            \"found existing worker sessions\"\n573\t        );\n574\t    }\n575\t\n576\t    // Reject --identifier collision early.\n577\t    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n578\t        if occupied.contains(id) {\n579\t            bail!(\n580\t                \"worker '{}' is already running in session 'needle-{}-{}'\",\n581\t                id,\n582\t                agent_name,\n583\t                id\n584\t            );\n585\t        }\n586\t    }\n587\t\n588\t    // Build the list of worker IDs, skipping occupied names.\n589\t    let worker_ids: Vec<String> = if effective_count == 1 {\n590\t        vec![identifier.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n591\t            // Pick the first available NATO name.\n592\t            NATO_ALPHABET\n593\t                .iter()\n594\t                .find(|name| !occupied.contains(**name))\n595\t                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n596\t                .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string())\n597\t        })]\n598\t    } else {\n599\t        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(effective_count as usize);\n600\t        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n601\t            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n602\t                break;\n603\t            }\n604\t            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n605\t                tracing::warn!(\n606\t                    worker_id = %name,\n607\t                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n608\t                );\n609\t                continue;\n610\t            }\n611\t            ids.push(name.to_string());\n612\t        }\n613\t        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n614\t            bail!(\n615\t                \"cannot launch {} workers — only since,\n            until,\n            idle_strands,\n        } => cmd_status(format, by_worker, cost, since, until, idle_strands),\n        CliCommand::Logs {\n            follow,\n            filter,\n            since,\n            until,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_logs(follow, filter, since, until, format),\n        CliCommand::ConfigCmd {\n            get,\n            set,\n            dump,\n            show_source,\n        } => cmd_config(get, set, dump, show_source),\n        CliCommand::Doctor { repair, workspace } => cmd_doctor(repair, workspace),\n        CliCommand::Init => cmd_init(),\n        CliCommand::Version => {\n            cmd_version();\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        CliCommand::TestAgent { name } => cmd_test_agent(&name),\n        CliCommand::Canary { status } => cmd_canary(status),\n        CliCommand::Upgrade { check } => cmd_upgrade(check),\n        CliCommand::Rollback => cmd_rollback(),\n        CliCommand::Reflect { workspace, force } => cmd_reflect(workspace, force),\n        CliCommand::UpdateRules { output } => cmd_update_rules(output),\n        CliCommand::Stats {\n            by,\n            since,\n            until,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_stats(by, since, until, format),\n        CliCommand::Supervise { workspace } => cmd_supervise(workspace),\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Command handlers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `needle run` — launch a worker.\n///\n/// Always creates dedicated tmux sessions for workers, even when invoked from\n/// inside an existing tmux session. The only exception is a re-entrant inner\n/// invocation launched by `launch_in_tmux()`, which is identified by the\n/// `NEEDLE_INNER=1` environment variable and runs the worker directly.\nfn cmd_run(\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    count: u32,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    resume: bool,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Determine workspace root (CLI arg → canonicalized, else global default).\n    let workspace_root = if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n    } else {\n        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n        global.workspace.default.clone()\n    };\n\n    // Load full resolved config (global → workspace .needle.yaml → env → CLI).\n    let cli_overrides = CliOverrides {\n        workspace: Some(workspace_root.clone()),\n        agent_binary: agent.clone(),\n        max_workers: None,\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n    let (mut config, _) = ConfigLoader::load_resolved(&workspace_root, cli_overrides)?;\n\n    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n        config.agent.timeout = t;\n    }\n\n    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n        config.self_modification.hot_reload = hr;\n    }\n\n    if resume {\n        // Hot-reload resume: inherit worker identity from --identifier,\n        // load state from heartbeat file + registry, continue from SELECTING.\n        let worker_id = identifier\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n\n        // Load resume state from heartbeat and registry.\n        let resume_state = crate::upgrade::ResumeState::load(&config, &worker_id)?;\n\n        // Emit upgrade.completed telemetry.\n        let current_hash = crate::upgrade::file_hash(\n            &std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?,\n        )\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n\n        match &resume_state {\n            Some(state) => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    worker = %worker_id,\n                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n                    beads_processed = state.beads_processed,\n                    session = %state.session,\n                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload\"\n                );\n            }\n            None => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    worker = %worker_id,\n                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload (no prior state found)\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(worker_id.clone(), &config.telemetry)\n            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n                crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(worker_id.clone())\n            });\n        tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::UpgradeCompleted {\n            new_hash: current_hash,\n        })?;\n\n        return run_worker(config, worker_id);\n    }\n\n    if is_needle_inner() {\n        // Re-entrant inner invocation launched by launch_in_tmux() — run\n        // the worker directly inside the dedicated session already created.\n        let worker_id = identifier\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n        let agent_name = agent.as_deref().unwrap_or(&config.agent.default);\n        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant invocation)\");\n        run_worker(config, worker_id)\n    } else {\n        // Always create dedicated tmux sessions, even if already inside tmux.\n        launch_workers(\n            config, workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, hot_reload,\n        )\n    }\n}\n\n/// Launch `count` workers in separate tmux sessions with staggered startup delays.\npub fn launch_workers(\n    config: Config,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    count: u32,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let agent_name = agent\n        .as_deref()\n        .unwrap_or(&config.agent.default)\n        .to_string();\n    let stagger_secs = config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds;\n    let max_workers = config.worker.max_workers;\n\n    if count == 0 {\n        bail!(\"--count must be at least 1\");\n    }\n    if count as usize > NATO_ALPHABET.len() {\n        bail!(\n            \"--count {} exceeds the maximum of {} (NATO alphabet size)\",\n            count,\n            NATO_ALPHABET.len()\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Enforce max_workers cap (0 means unlimited).\n    let effective_count = if max_workers > 0 && count > max_workers {\n        tracing::warn!(\n            requested = count,\n            capped_to = max_workers,\n            \"count exceeds max_workers; capping\"\n        );\n        eprintln!(\n            \"Warning: --count {count} exceeds max_workers={max_workers}; launching {max_workers} workers\"\n        );\n        max_workers\n    } else {\n        count\n    };\n\n    // --identifier is only meaningful for a single worker.\n    if effective_count > 1 && identifier.is_some() {\n        bail!(\"--identifier cannot be combined with --count > 1; identifiers are auto-assigned from the NATO alphabet\");\n    }\n\n    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n        tracing::info!(\n            occupied = ?occupied,\n            \"found existing worker sessions\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Reject --identifier collision early.\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        if occupied.contains(id) {\n            bail!(\n                \"worker '{}' is already running in session 'needle-{}-{}'\",\n                id,\n                agent_name,\n                id\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Build the list of worker IDs, skipping occupied names.\n    let worker_ids: Vec<String> = if effective_count == 1 {\n        vec![identifier.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n            // Pick the first available NATO name.\n            NATO_ALPHABET\n                .iter()\n                .find(|name| !occupied.contains(**name))\n                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string())\n        })]\n    } else {\n        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(effective_count as usize);\n        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n                break;\n            }\n            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    worker_id = %name,\n                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n                );\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids.push(name.to_string());\n        }\n        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n            bail!(\n                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n                effective_count,\n                ids.len(),\n                occupied.len()\n            );\n        }\n        ids\n    };\n\n    for (seq, worker_id) in worker_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            worker_id = %worker_id,\n            sequence = seq,\n            total = effective_count,\n            session = %session_name,\n            \"launching worker\"\n        );\n\n        // Stagger: sleep before launching subsequent workers.\n        if seq > 0 && stagger_secs > 0 {\n            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(stagger_secs));\n        }\n\n        launch_in_tmux(\n            &session_name,\n            workspace.clone(),\n            agent.clone(),\n            Some(worker_id.clone()),\n            timeout,\n            hot_reload,\n        )?;\n\n        println!(\n            \"[{}/{}] Started worker '{}' in tmux session: {session_name}\",\n            seq + 1,\n            effective_count,\n            worker_id\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sanitized_agent = sanitize_session_name(&agent_name);\n    if effective_count > 1 {\n        println!(\n            \"\\nStarted {effective_count} workers (stagger: {stagger_secs}s between launches).\"\n        );\n        println!(\"Attach to a worker with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-<name>\");\n    } else {\n        let worker_id = &worker_ids[0];\n        println!(\"Attach with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-{worker_id}\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Initialize the tracing subscriber with OTLP layer if configured.\n///\n/// This must be called before any tracing spans are created so that the OTLP\n/// layer can export them to the configured collector.\n///\n/// Note: Shutdown is handled by the OtlpSink in the telemetry module, not here.\n#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    worker_id: String,\n    session_id: String,\n    config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use opentelemetry::trace::TracerProvider;\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Check if OTLP is enabled\n    if !config.telemetry.otlp_sink.enabled {\n        // No OTLP - just initialize with fmt layer\n        let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi);\n        tracing_subscriber::registry()\n            .with(fmt_layer)\n            .try_init()\n            .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // OTLP is enabled - create the OTLP layer inline\n    // We create it inline to avoid type erasure issues with boxed layers\n    let otlp_config = &config.telemetry.otlp_sink;\n\n    // Build resource attributes\n    let resource = crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_resource(\n        &worker_id,\n        &session_id,\n        otlp_config,\n        Some(&config.agent.default),\n        None, // model - not available in AgentConfig\n        config.workspace.default.to_str(),\n    )\n    .context(\"failed to build OTel resource\")?;\n\n    // Create drop channel for tracing layer\n    let (drop_tx, mut drop_rx) =\n        tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<crate::telemetry::otlp::DropEvent>();\n    tokio::spawn(async move {\n        while let Some(drop) = drop_rx.recv().await {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                signal = drop.signal.as_str(),\n                dropped_count = drop.dropped_count,\n                \"OTLP tracing layer export failure\"\n            );\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Build exporters and tracer provider based on protocol\n    let (tracer_provider, ..) = match otlp_config.protocol.as_str() {\n        \"grpc\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_grpc_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        \"http\" | \"http/protobuf\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_http_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        other => anyhow::bail!(\"invalid OTLP protocol: {other}, must be 'grpc' or 'http'\"),\n    };\n\n    // Create the OpenTelemetry tracing layer\n    let otlp_layer = tracing_opentelemetry::layer().with_tracer(tracer_provider.tracer(\"needle\"));\n\n    // Create a fmt layer that works with any subscriber implementing LookupSpan\n    // We build this after the OTLP layer to ensure proper type compatibility\n    let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::registry().with(otlp_layer).with(\n        tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n    );\n\n    subscriber\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber with OTLP\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// No-op tracing initialization when OTLP feature is disabled.\n#[cfg(not(feature = \"otlp\"))]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    _worker_id: String,\n    _session_id: String,\n    _config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Initialize with just the stdout layer when OTLP is disabled\n    tracing_subscriber::registry()\n        .with(\n            tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n                .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n                .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n        )\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Helper function to determine ANSI support (non-Android platforms).\n#[cfg(not(target_os = \"android\"))]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    atty::is(atty::Stream::Stderr)\n}\n\n/// Helper function for Android (no ANSI).\n#[cfg(target_os = \"android\")]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    false\n}\n\n/// Generate a session ID for a worker.\n///\n/// Uses the telemetry module's session ID generator.\nfn generate_session_id_for_worker() -> String {\n    crate::telemetry::generate_session_id()\n}\n\n/// Start the worker state machine (called when inside tmux or for direct mode).\n///\n/// Creates telemetry and the tokio runtime *before* any other initialization\n/// so that `worker.booting` is the very first JSONL event. Each subsequent\n/// init step is wrapped with `init.step.started` / `init.step.completed` so a\n/// silent hang pinpoints the exact blocking call.\nfn run_worker(config: Config, worker_name: String) -> Result<()> {\n    let boot_start = Instant::now();\n    let qualified_id = format!(\"{}-{}\", config.agent.default, worker_name);\n\n    // Phase 0: create tokio runtime + telemetry, emit worker.booting immediately.\n    // Emit eprintln diagnostics before each step so hangs are visible even if telemetry fails.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating tokio runtime...\");\n    let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().context(\"failed to create tokio runtime\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tokio runtime created\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: initializing tracing subscriber...\");\n    let session_id = generate_session_id_for_worker();\n    init_tracing_subscriber(qualified_id.clone(), session_id.clone(), &config)?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tracing subscriber initialized\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating telemetry...\");\n    let telemetry =\n        Telemetry::from_config(qualified_id.clone(), &config.telemetry).unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to create hook-enabled telemetry, falling back\");\n            Telemetry::new(qualified_id.clone())\n        });\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: telemetry created\");\n\n    // Emit worker.booting SYNCHRONOUSLY before starting the async writer.\n    // This guarantees the event is written to disk even if start_and_wait() hangs.\n    // Fixes the silent pre-init deadlock where the JSONL file is created but empty.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: emitting worker.booting event (sync)...\");\n    telemetry.emit_sync(EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n        worker_name: worker_name.clone(),\n        version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: worker.booting written to disk\");\n\n    // Start the async writer thread after worker.booting is on disk.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting telemetry writer thread...\");\n    rt.block_on(telemetry.start_and_wait())\n        .context(\"writer thread failed to start\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: writer thread started\");\n\n    // Phase 1: bead store discovery.\n    // Use BfCliBeadStore for atomic server-selected bead claiming.\n    let store: Arc<dyn crate::bead_store::BeadStore> =\n        Arc::new(init_step(\"bead_store_discover\", &telemetry, || {\n            crate::bead_store::BfCliBeadStore::discover(\n                config.workspace.default.clone(),\n                None,                       // model: do not filter by model — beads are untagged\n                Some(\"needle\".to_string()), // harness\n                Some(env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string()), // harness_version\n            )\n            .context(\"failed to locate bf CLI for bead store\")\n        })?);\n\n    // Phase 2: worker construction (heavy — prompt loading, adapter discovery, etc.).\n    let mut worker = init_step(\"worker_construction\", &telemetry, || {\n        Ok(Worker::new_with_telemetry(\n            config,\n            worker_name.clone(),\n            store,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        ))\n    })?;\n\n    // Boot timeout guard: self-abort if init took >60 s.\n    let elapsed_ms = boot_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    if elapsed_ms > 60_000 {\n        telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms })?;\n        bail!(\"boot exceeded 60 s ({elapsed_ms} ms), aborting\");\n    }\n\n    eprintln!(\n        \"NEEDLE worker boot: all init steps completed in {elapsed_ms}ms, starting worker loop...\"\n    );\n    let result = rt.block_on(worker.run())?;\n\n    tracing::info!(final_state = %result, \"worker finished\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Emit start/complete telemetry around a fallible initialization step.\n///\n/// Each step's completion is force-flushed to disk so that if a subsequent\n/// step blocks indefinitely, the telemetry log shows exactly where it stopped.\n/// Also emits eprintln diagnostics for visibility even if telemetry hangs.\nfn init_step<T, F>(name: &str, tel: &Telemetry, f: F) -> Result<T>\nwhere\n    F: FnOnce() -> Result<T>,\n{\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting init step '{name}'...\");\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepStarted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n    })?;\n    let t = Instant::now();\n    let result = f();\n    let elapsed = t.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepCompleted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n        duration_ms: elapsed,\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: init step '{name}' completed in {elapsed}ms\");\n    // Force-flush so the step completion is visible before the next (potentially blocking) step.\n    tel.force_flush(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1))?;\n    result\n}\n\n/// Returns true when this process is a re-entrant inner invocation launched\n/// by `launch_in_tmux()`, indicated by `NEEDLE_INNER=1` in the environment.\nfn is_needle_inner() -> bool {\n    std::env::var(\"NEEDLE_INNER\").is_ok_and(|v| v == \"1\")\n}\n\n/// Create a single tmux session and re-exec self inside it with `--count 1`.\nfn launch_in_tmux(\n    session_name: &str,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Build the command that tmux will run inside the session.\n    let self_exe = std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?;\n    let mut inner_args = vec![\"run\".to_string()];\n\n    if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        inner_args.push(\"--workspace\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(ws.display().to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(ref a) = agent {\n        inner_args.push(\"--agent\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(a.clone());\n    }\n    // Each session runs exactly one worker; identifier is always resolved before call.\n    inner_args.push(\"--count\".to_string());\n    inner_args.push(\"1\".to_string());\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        inner_args.push(\"--identifier\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(id.clone());\n    }\n    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n        inner_args.push(\"--timeout\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(t.to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n        inner_args.push(\"--hot-reload\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(hr.to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Build stderr log path: ~/.needle/logs/<session_name>.stderr.log\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \".\".to_string());\n    let stderr_log = format!(\"{home}/.needle/logs/{session_name}.stderr.log\");\n\n    let inner_cmd = format!(\n        \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 {} {} 2>> {}\",\n        shell_escape(&self_exe.display().to_string()),\n        inner_args\n            .iter()\n            .map(|a| shell_escape(a))\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\" \"),\n        shell_escape(&stderr_log)\n    );\n\n    let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\"new-session\", \"-d\", \"-s\", session_name, &inner_cmd])\n        .status()\n        .context(\"failed to launch tmux — is tmux installed?\")?;\n\n    if !status.success() {\n        bail!(\n            \"tmux new-session exited with status {} for session '{}'\",\n            status,\n            session_name\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle stop` — send SIGTERM to worker processes in tmux sessions.\nfn cmd_stop(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    if !all && identifier.is_none() {\n        bail!(\"specify --all or --identifier <NAME>\");\n    }\n\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    for session in &targets {\n        tracing::info!(session = %session, \"sending SIGTERM to tmux session\");\n        // tmux send-keys sends C-c to the foreground process\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"send-keys\", \"-t\", session, \"C-c\", \"\"])\n            .status()\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to send SIGTERM to session '{session}'\"))?;\n\n        if status.success() {\n            // Wait up to 5 seconds for the worker to exit gracefully\n            for _ in 0..50 {\n                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));\n                let session_exists = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                    .args([\"has-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                    .output()\n                    .map(|o| o.status.success())\n                    .unwrap_or(false);\n                if !session_exists {\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            // Kill the session to clean up (worker may have already exited)\n            let kill_status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                .status();\n            match kill_status {\n                Ok(s) if s.success() => println!(\"Stopped: {session}\"),\n                Ok(_) => println!(\"Stopped: {session} (session already gone)\"),\n                Err(e) => println!(\"Warning: stopped {session} but failed to kill session: {e}\"),\n            }\n        } else {\n            println!(\"Warning: could not stop session '{session}' (status: {status})\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle cleanup` — remove orphaned tmux sessions.\n///\n/// Finds and removes needle tmux sessions that no longer have active workers.\n/// With --all, removes all needle sessions regardless of worker status.\nfn cmd_cleanup(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| id.is_empty() || s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let mut cleaned = 0;\n    for session in &targets {\n        // Kill the session\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n            .status();\n\n        match status {\n            Ok(s) if s.success() => {\n                println!(\"Cleaned up: {session}\");\n                cleaned += 1;\n            }\n            Ok(_) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: session '{session}' already gone\");\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: failed to cleanup session '{session}': {e}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if cleaned == 0 {\n        println!(\"No sessions cleaned up.\");\n    } else {\n        println!(\"Cleaned up {cleaned} session(s).\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle list` — show running needle sessions.\nfn cmd_list(format: ListFormat) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if \"-\".repeat(70));\n            for s in &sessions {\n                println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", s.name, s.created, s.status);\n            }\n        }\n        ListFormat::Json => {\n Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle init` — initialize v2 config with optional v1 migration.\n///\n/// Creates ~/.config/needle/config.yaml. Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        bail!(\"no needle sessions running\");\n    }\n\n    // Find matching session: exact match on identifier portion or substring match on full name.\n    let matches: Vec<&TmuxSession> = sessions\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|s| s.name.ends_with(&format!(\"-{identifier}\")) || s.name.contains(identifier))\n        .collect();\n\n    if matches.is_empty() {\n        let available: Vec<&str> = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect();\n        bail!(\n            \"no session matching '{}'; available: {}\",\n            identifier,\n            available.join(\", \")\n        );\n    }\n\n    if matches.len() > 1 {\n        let names: Vec<&str> = matches.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect();\n        bail!(\n            \"ambiguous identifier '{}'; matches: {}\",\n            identifier,\n            names.join(\", \")\n        );\n    }\n\n    let session = &matches[0].name;\n    let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\"attach-session\", \"-t\", session])\n        .status()\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to attach to tmux session '{session}'\"))?;\n\n    if !status.success() {\n        bail!(\"tmux attach-session exited with status {status} for '{session}'\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle status` — show fleet status summary.\nfn cmd_status(\n    format: ListFormat,\n    by_worker: bool,\n    cost: bool,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    until: Option<String>,\n Safe to run on already-\n    /// initialized installs (idempotent).\n    Init,\n\n    /// Show version information.\n    Version,\n\n    /// Validate an agent adapter.\n    TestAgent {\n        /// Name of the adapter to test.\n        name: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Run canary tests against a :testing binary.\n    Canary {\n        /// Show channel status instead of running tests.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        status: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Check for and install updates from GitHub releases.\n    Upgrade {\n        /// Check only — show available update without installing.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        check: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Rollback to the previous :stable binary.\n    Rollback,\n\n    /// Run learning consolidation on demand.\n    ///\n    /// Reads bead close bodies since the last consolidation, extracts\n    /// retrospective patterns, merges them into learnings.md, and promotes\n    /// high-frequency learnings to skill files.\n    Reflect {\n        /// Workspace to consolidate (defaults to config workspace).\n        #[arg(short = 'w', long)]\n        workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n\n        /// Skip cooldown and minimum bead threshold checks.\n        #[arg(long)]\n        force: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Fetch the latest gitleaks rules and update the vendored config.\n    ///\n    /// Downloads gitleaks.toml from the upstream GitHub repository, validates\n    /// it by compiling all rules, and writes it to the output path.\n    /// Rebuild needle after running this command to embed the new rules.\n    #[command(name = \"update-rules\")]\n    UpdateRules {\n        /// Destination path for the downloaded config (default: config/gitleaks.toml).\n        #[arg(short = 'o', long)]\n        output: Option<PathBuf>,\n    },\n\n    /// Show outcome statistics aggregated from telemetry logs.\n    ///\n    /// Reads JSONL telemetry files, correlates dispatch/outcome/effort events\n    /// by bead ID, and prints per-group statistics.\n    ///\n    /// Examples:\n    ///   needle stats --by template_version --since 7d\n    ///   needle stats --by task_type --since 30d\n    ///   needle stats --by worker --since 7d --format json\n    Stats {\n        /// Dimension to group results by.\n        #[arg(long, value_enum)]\n        by: StatsBy,\n\n        /// Include only events since this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        since: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Include only events until this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z).\n        #[arg(long)]\n        until: Option<String>,\n\n        /// Output format.\n        #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value = \"table\")]\n        format: ListFormat,\n    },\n\n    /// Run the fleet supervisor daemon (auto-scale workers based on queue depth).\n    Supervise {\n        /// Workspace to monitor (defaults to config workspace).\n        #[arg(short = 'w', long)]\n        workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    },\n}\n\n/// Output format for the list command.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\npub enum ListFormat {\n    Table,\n    Json,\n}\n\n/// Output format for the logs command.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\npub enum LogFormat {\n    /// Human-readable table format (default).\n    Table,\n    /// JSON Lines format (one JSON object per line).\n    Json,\n    /// Alias for table (human-readable).\n    Human,\n    /// Alias for json (JSON Lines).\n    Jsonl,\n}\n\n/// Grouping dimension for the `needle stats` command.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\npub enum StatsBy {\n    /// Group by template version tag (e.g., `\"pluck-v2\"`).\n    #[value(name = \"template_version\")]\n    TemplateVersion,\n    /// Group by template name / task type (e.g., `\"pluck\"`).\n    #[value(name = \"task_type\")]\n    TaskType,\n    /// Group by worker identifier (e.g., `\"needle-alpha\"`).\n    #[value(name = \"worker\")]\n    Worker,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Entry point\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Entry point called from `main`.\npub fn run() -> Result<()> {\n    let cli = Cli::parse();\n\n    match cli.command {\n        CliCommand::Run {\n            workspace,\n            agent,\n            count,\n            identifier,\n            timeout,\n            resume,\n            hot_reload,\n        } => cmd_run(\n            workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, resume, hot_reload,\n        ),\n        CliCommand::Stop { all, identifier } => cmd_stop(all, identifier),\n        CliCommand::Cleanup { all, identifier } => cmd_cleanup(all, identifier),\n        CliCommand::List { format } => cmd_list(format),\n        CliCommand::Attach { identifier } => cmd_attach(&identifier),\n        CliCommand::Status {\n            format,\n            by_worker,\n            cost,\n            since,\n            until,\n            idle_strands,\n        } => cmd_status(format, by_worker, cost, since, until, idle_strands),\n        CliCommand::Logs {\n            follow,\n            filter,\n            since,\n            until,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_logs(follow, filter, since, until, format),\n        CliCommand::ConfigCmd {\n            get,\n            set,\n            dump,\n            show_source,\n        } => cmd_config(get, set, dump, show_source),\n        CliCommand::Doctor { repair, workspace } => cmd_doctor(repair, workspace),\n        CliCommand::Init => cmd_init(),\n        CliCommand::Version => {\n            cmd_version();\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        CliCommand::TestAgent { name } => cmd_test_agent(&name),\n        CliCommand::Canary { status } => cmd_canary(status),\n        CliCommand::Upgrade { check } => cmd_upgrade(check),\n        CliCommand::Rollback => cmd_rollback(),\n        CliCommand::Reflect { workspace, force } => cmd_reflect(workspace, force),\n        CliCommand::UpdateRules { output } => cmd_update_rules(output),\n        CliCommand::Stats {\n            by,\n            since,\n            until,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_stats(by, since, until, format),\n        CliCommand::Supervise { workspace } => cmd_supervise(workspace),\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Command handlers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `needle run` — launch a worker.\n///\n/// Always creates dedicated tmux sessions for workers, even when invoked from\n/// inside an existing tmux session. The only exception is a re-entrant inner\n/// invocation launched by `launch_in_tmux()`, which is identified by the\n/// `NEEDLE_INNER=1` environment variable and runs the worker directly.\nfn cmd_run(\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    count: u32,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    resume: bool,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Determine workspace root (CLI arg → canonicalized, else global default).\n    let workspace_root = if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n    } else {\n        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n        global.workspace.default.clone()\n    };\n\n    // Load full resolved config (global → workspace .needle.yaml → env → CLI).\n    let cli_overrides = CliOverrides {\n        workspace: Some(workspace_root.clone()),\n        agent_binary: agent.clone(),\n        max_workers: None,\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n    let (mut config, _) = ConfigLoader::load_resolved(&workspace_root, cli_overrides)?;\n\n    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n        config.agent.timeout = t;\n    }\n\n    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n        config.self_modification.hot_reload = hr;\n    }\n\n    if resume {\n        // Hot-reload resume: inherit worker identity from --identifier,\n        // load state from heartbeat file + registry, continue from SELECTING.\n        let worker_id = identifier\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n\n        // Load resume state from heartbeat and registry.\n        let resume_state = crate::upgrade::ResumeState::load(&config, &worker_id)?;\n\n        // Emit upgrade.completed telemetry.\n        let current_hash = crate::upgrade::file_hash(\n            &std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?,\n        )\n        .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n\n        match &resume_state {\n            Some(state) => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    worker = %worker_id,\n                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n                    beads_processed = state.beads_processed,\n                    session = %state.session,\n                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload\"\n                );\n            }\n            None => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    worker = %worker_id,\n                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload (no prior state found)\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(worker_id.clone(), &config.telemetry)\n            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n                crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(worker_id.clone())\n            });\n        tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::UpgradeCompleted {\n            new_hash: current_hash,\n        })?;\n\n        return run_worker(config, worker_id);\n    }\n\n    if is_needle_inner() {\n        // Re-entrant inner invocation launched by launch_in_tmux() — run\n        // the worker directly inside the dedicated session already created.\n        let worker_id = identifier\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n        let agent_name = agent.as_deref().unwrap_or(&config.agent.default);\n        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant invocation)\");\n        run_worker(config, worker_id)\n    } else {\n        // Always create dedicated tmux sessions, even if already inside tmux.\n        launch_workers(\n            config, workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, hot_reload,\n        )\n    }\n}\n\n/// Launch `count` workers in separate tmux sessions with staggered startup delays.\npub fn launch_workers(\n    config: Config,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    count: u32,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let agent_name = agent\n        .as_deref()\n        .unwrap_or(&config.agent.default)\n        .to_string();\n    let stagger_secs = config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds;\n    let max_workers = config.worker.max_workers;\n\n    if count == 0 {\n        bail!(\"--count must be at least 1\");\n    }\n    if count as usize > NATO_ALPHABET.len() {\n        bail!(\n            \"--count {} exceeds the maximum of {} (NATO alphabet size)\",\n            count,\n            NATO_ALPHABET.len()\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Enforce max_workers cap (0 means unlimited).\n    let effective_count = if max_workers > 0 && count > max_workers {\n        tracing::warn!(\n            requested = count,\n            capped_to = max_workers,\n            \"count exceeds max_workers; capping\"\n        );\n        eprintln!(\n            \"Warning: --count {count} exceeds max_workers={max_workers}; launching {max_workers} workers\"\n        );\n        max_workers\n    } else {\n        count\n    };\n\n    // --identifier is only meaningful for a single worker.\n    if effective_count > 1 && identifier.is_some() {\n        bail!(\"--identifier cannot be combined with --count > 1; identifiers are auto-assigned from the NATO alphabet\");\n    }\n\n    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n        tracing::info!(\n            occupied = ?occupied,\n            \"found existing worker sessions\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Reject --identifier collision early.\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        if occupied.contains(id) {\n            bail!(\n                \"worker '{}' is already running in session 'needle-{}-{}'\",\n                id,\n                agent_name,\n                id\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Build the list of worker IDs, skipping occupied names.\n    let worker_ids: Vec<String> = if effective_count == 1 {\n        vec![identifier.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n            // Pick the first available NATO name.\n            NATO_ALPHABET\n                .iter()\n                .find(|name| !occupied.contains(**name))\n                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string())\n        })]\n    } else {\n        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(effective_count as usize);\n        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n                break;\n            }\n            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    worker_id = %name,\n                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n                );\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids.push(name.to_string());\n        }\n        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n            bail!(\n                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n                effective_count,\n                ids.len(),\n                occupied.len()\n            );\n        }\n        ids\n    };\n\n    for (seq, worker_id) in worker_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            worker_id = %worker_id,\n            sequence = seq,\n            total = effective_count,\n            session = %session_name,\n            \"launching worker\"\n        );\n\n        // Stagger: sleep before launching subsequent workers.\n        if seq > 0 && stagger_secs > 0 {\n            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(stagger_secs));\n        }\n\n        launch_in_tmux(\n            &session_name,\n            workspace.clone(),\n            agent.clone(),\n            Some(worker_id.clone()),\n            timeout,\n            hot_reload,\n        )?;\n\n        println!(\n            \"[{}/{}] Started worker '{}' in tmux session: {session_name}\",\n            seq + 1,\n            effective_count,\n            worker_id\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sanitized_agent = sanitize_session_name(&agent_name);\n    if effective_count > 1 {\n        println!(\n            \"\\nStarted {effective_count} workers (stagger: {stagger_secs}s between launches).\"\n        );\n        println!(\"Attach to a worker with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-<name>\");\n    } else {\n        let worker_id = &worker_ids[0];\n        println!(\"Attach with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-{worker_id}\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Initialize the tracing subscriber with OTLP layer if configured.\n///\n/// This must be called before any tracing spans are created so that the OTLP\n/// layer can export them to the configured collector.\n///\n/// Note: Shutdown is handled by the OtlpSink in the telemetry module, not here.\n#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    worker_id: String,\n    session_id: String,\n    config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use opentelemetry::trace::TracerProvider;\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Check if OTLP is enabled\n    if !config.telemetry.otlp_sink.enabled {\n        // No OTLP - just initialize with fmt layer\n        let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi);\n        tracing_subscriber::registry()\n            .with(fmt_layer)\n            .try_init()\n            .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // OTLP is enabled - create the OTLP layer inline\n    // We create it inline to avoid type erasure issues with boxed layers\n    let otlp_config = &config.telemetry.otlp_sink;\n\n    // Build resource attributes\n    let resource = crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_resource(\n        &worker_id,\n        &session_id,\n        otlp_config,\n        Some(&config.agent.default),\n        None, // model - not available in AgentConfig\n        config.workspace.default.to_str(),\n    )\n    .context(\"failed to build OTel resource\")?;\n\n    // Create drop channel for tracing layer\n    let (drop_tx, mut drop_rx) =\n        tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<crate::telemetry::otlp::DropEvent>();\n    tokio::spawn(async move {\n        while let Some(drop) = drop_rx.recv().await {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                signal = drop.signal.as_str(),\n                dropped_count = drop.dropped_count,\n                \"OTLP tracing layer export failure\"\n            );\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Build exporters and tracer provider based on protocol\n    let (tracer_provider, ..) = match otlp_config.protocol.as_str() {\n        \"grpc\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_grpc_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        \"http\" | \"http/protobuf\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_http_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        other => anyhow::bail!(\"invalid OTLP protocol: {other}, must be 'grpc' or 'http'\"),\n    };\n\n    // Create the OpenTelemetry tracing layer\n    let otlp_layer = tracing_opentelemetry::layer().with_tracer(tracer_provider.tracer(\"needle\"));\n\n    // Create a fmt layer that works with any subscriber implementing LookupSpan\n    // We build this after the OTLP layer to ensure proper type compatibility\n    let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::registry().with(otlp_layer).with(\n        tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n    );\n\n    subscriber\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber with OTLP\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// No-op tracing initialization when OTLP feature is disabled.\n#[cfg(not(feature = \"otlp\"))]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    _worker_id: String,\n    _session_id: String,\n    _config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Initialize with just the stdout layer when OTLP is disabled\n    tracing_subscriber::registry()\n        .with(\n            tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n                .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n                .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n        )\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Helper function to determine ANSI support (non-Android platforms).\n#[cfg(not(target_os = \"android\"))]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    atty::is(atty::Stream::Stderr)\n}\n\n/// Helper function for Android (no ANSI).\n#[cfg(target_os = \"android\")]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    false\n}\n\n/// Generate a session ID for a worker.\n///\n/// Uses the telemetry module's session ID generator.\nfn generate_session_id_for_worker() -> String {\n    crate::telemetry::generate_session_id()\n}\n\n/// Start the worker state machine (called when inside tmux or for direct mode).\n///\n/// Creates telemetry and the tokio runtime *before* any other initialization\n/// so that `worker.booting` is the very first JSONL event. Each subsequent\n/// init step is wrapped with `init.step.started` / `init.step.completed` so a\n/// silent hang pinpoints the exact blocking call.\nfn run_worker(config: Config, worker_name: String) -> Result<()> {\n    let boot_start = Instant::now();\n    let qualified_id = format!(\"{}-{}\", config.agent.default, worker_name);\n\n    // Phase 0: create tokio runtime + telemetry, emit worker.booting immediately.\n    // Emit eprintln diagnostics before each step so hangs are visible even if telemetry fails.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating tokio runtime...\");\n    let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().context(\"failed to create tokio runtime\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tokio runtime created\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: initializing tracing subscriber...\");\n    let session_id = generate_session_id_for_worker();\n    init_tracing_subscriber(qualified_id.clone(), session_id.clone(), &config)?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tracing subscriber initialized\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating telemetry...\");\n    let telemetry =\n        Telemetry::from_config(qualified_id.clone(), &config.telemetry).unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to create hook-enabled telemetry, falling back\");\n            Telemetry::new(qualified_id.clone())\n        });\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: telemetry created\");\n\n    // Emit worker.booting SYNCHRONOUSLY before starting the async writer.\n    // This guarantees the event is written to disk even if start_and_wait() hangs.\n    // Fixes the silent pre-init deadlock where the JSONL file is created but empty.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: emitting worker.booting event (sync)...\");\n    telemetry.emit_sync(EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n        worker_name: worker_name.clone(),\n        version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: worker.booting written to disk\");\n\n    // Start the async writer thread after worker.booting is on disk.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting telemetry writer thread...\");\n    rt.block_on(telemetry.start_and_wait())\n        .context(\"writer thread failed to start\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: writer thread started\");\n\n    // Phase 1: bead store discovery.\n    // Use BfCliBeadStore for atomic server-selected bead claiming.\n    let store: Arc<dyn crate::bead_store::BeadStore> =\n        Arc::new(init_step(\"bead_store_discover\", &telemetry, || {\n            crate::bead_store::BfCliBeadStore::discover(\n                config.workspace.default.clone(),\n                None,                       // model: do not filter by model — beads are untagged\n                Some(\"needle\".to_string()), // harness\n                Some(env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string()), // harness_version\n            )\n            .context(\"failed to locate bf CLI for bead store\")\n        })?);\n\n    // Phase 2: worker construction (heavy — prompt loading, adapter discovery, etc.).\n    let mut worker = init_step(\"worker_construction\", &telemetry, || {\n        Ok(Worker::new_with_telemetry(\n            config,\n            worker_name.clone(),\n            store,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        ))\n    })?;\n\n    // Boot timeout guard: self-abort if init took >60 s.\n    let elapsed_ms = boot_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    if elapsed_ms > 60_000 {\n        telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms })?;\n        bail!(\"boot exceeded 60 s ({elapsed_ms} ms), aborting\");\n    }\n\n    eprintln!(\n        \"NEEDLE worker boot: all init steps completed in {elapsed_ms}ms, starting worker loop...\"\n    );\n    let result = rt.block_on(worker.run())?;\n\n    tracing::info!(final_state = %result, \"worker finished\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Emit start/complete telemetry around a fallible initialization step.\n///\n/// Each step's completion is force-flushed to disk so that if a subsequent\n/// step blocks indefinitely, the telemetry log shows exactly where it stopped.\n/// Also emits eprintln diagnostics for visibility even if telemetry hangs.\nfn init_step<T, F>(name: &str, tel: &Telemetry, f: F) -> Result<T>\nwhere\n    F: FnOnce() -> Result<T>,\n{\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting init step '{name}'...\");\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepStarted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n    })?;\n    let t = Instant::now();\n    let result = f();\n    let elapsed = t.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepCompleted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n        duration_ms: elapsed,\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: init step '{name}' completed in {elapsed}ms\");\n    // Force-flush so the step completion is visible before the next (potentially blocking) step.\n    tel.force_flush(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1))?;\n    result\n}\n\n/// Returns true when this process is a re-entrant inner invocation launched\n/// by `launch_in_tmux()`, indicated by `NEEDLE_INNER=1` in the environment.\nfn is_needle_inner() -> bool {\n    std::env::var(\"NEEDLE_INNER\").is_ok_and(|v| v == \"1\")\n}\n\n/// Create a single tmux session and re-exec self inside it with `--count 1`.\nfn launch_in_tmux(\n    session_name: &str,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Build the command that tmux will run inside the session.\n    let self_exe = std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?;\n    let mut inner_args = vec![\"run\".to_string()];\n\n    if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        inner_args.push(\"--workspace\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(ws.display().to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(ref a) = agent {\n        inner_args.push(\"--agent\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(a.clone());\n    }\n    // Each session runs exactly one worker; identifier is always resolved before call.\n    inner_args.push(\"--count\".to_string());\n    inner_args.push(\"1\".to_string());\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        inner_args.push(\"--identifier\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(id.clone());\n    }\n    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n        inner_args.push(\"--timeout\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(t.to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n        inner_args.push(\"--hot-reload\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(hr.to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Build stderr log path: ~/.needle/logs/<session_name>.stderr.log\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \".\".to_string());\n    let stderr_log = format!(\"{home}/.needle/logs/{session_name}.stderr.log\");\n\n    let inner_cmd = format!(\n        \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 {} {} 2>> {}\",\n        shell_escape(&self_exe.display().to_string()),\n        inner_args\n            .iter()\n            .map(|a| shell_escape(a))\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\" \"),\n        shell_escape(&stderr_log)\n    );\n\n    let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\"new-session\", \"-d\", \"-s\", session_name, &inner_cmd])\n        .status()\n        .context(\"failed to launch tmux — is tmux installed?\")?;\n\n    if !status.success() {\n        bail!(\n            \"tmux new-session exited with status {} for session '{}'\",\n            status,\n            session_name\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle stop` — send SIGTERM to worker processes in tmux sessions.\nfn cmd_stop(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    if !all && identifier.is_none() {\n        bail!(\"specify --all or --identifier <NAME>\");\n    }\n\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    for session in &targets {\n        tracing::info!(session = %session, \"sending SIGTERM to tmux session\");\n        // tmux send-keys sends C-c to the foreground process\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"send-keys\", \"-t\", session, \"C-c\", \"\"])\n            .status()\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to send SIGTERM to session '{session}'\"))?;\n\n        if status.success() {\n            // Wait up to 5 seconds for the worker to exit gracefully\n            for _ in 0..50 {\n                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));\n                let session_exists = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                    .args([\"has-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                    .output()\n                    .map(|o| o.status.success())\n                    .unwrap_or(false);\n                if !session_exists {\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            // Kill the session to clean up (worker may have already exited)\n            let kill_status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                .status();\n            match kill_status {\n                Ok(s) if s.success() => println!(\"Stopped: {session}\"),\n                Ok(_) => println!(\"Stopped: {session} (session already gone)\"),\n                Err(e) => println!(\"Warning: stopped {session} but failed to kill session: {e}\"),\n            }\n        } else {\n            println!(\"Warning: could not stop session '{session}' (status: {status})\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle cleanup` — remove orphaned tmux sessions.\n///\n/// Finds and removes needle tmux sessions that no longer have active workers.\n/// With --all, removes all needle sessions regardless of worker status.\nfn cmd_cleanup(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| id.is_empty() || s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let mut cleaned = 0;\n    for session in &targets {\n        // Kill the session\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n            .status();\n\n        match status {\n            Ok(s) if s.success() => {\n                println!(\"Cleaned up: {session}\");\n                cleaned += 1;\n            }\n            Ok(_) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: session '{session}' already gone\");\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: failed to cleanup session '{session}': {e}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if cleaned == 0 {\n        println!(\"No sessions cleaned up.\");\n    } else {\n        println!(\"Cleaned up {cleaned} session(s).\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle list` — show running needle sessions.\nfn cmd_list(format: ListFormat) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        match format {\n            ListFormat::Table => println!(\"No needle sessions running.\"),\n            ListFormat::Json => println!(\"[]\"),\n        }\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    match format {\n        ListFormat::Table => {\n            println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", \"SESSION\", \"CREATED\", \"STATUS\");\n            println!(\"{}\", \"-\".repeat(70));\n            for s in &sessions {\n                println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", s.name, s.created, s.status);\n            }\n        }\n        ListFormat::Json => {\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&sessions)\n                .context(\"failed to serialize sessions to JSON\")?;\n            println!(\"{json}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle init` — initialize v2 config with optional v1 migration.\n///\n/// Creates ~/.config/needle/config.yaml. Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        bail!(\"no needle sessions running\");\n    }\n\n    // Find matching session: exact match on identifier portion or substring match on full name.\n    let matches: Vec<&TmuxSession> = sessions\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|s| s.name.ends_with(&format!(\"-{identifier}\")) || \"no session matching '{}'; available: {}\",\n            identifier,\n            available.join(\", \")\n        );\n    }\n\n    if matches.len() > 1 {\n        let names: Vec<&str> = matches.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect();\n        bail!(\n            \"ambiguous identifier '{}'; matches: {}\",\n            identifier,\n            names.join(\", \")\n        );\n    }\n\n    let session = &matches[0].name;\n    let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\"attach-session\", \"-t\", session])\n        .status()\n        .with_context(|| Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle status` — show fleet status summary.\nfn cmd_status(\n    format: ListFormat,\n    by_worker: bool,\n    cost: bool,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    until: Option<String>,\n    idle_strands: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let needle_home = config.workspace.home.clone();\n    let registry = let active_count = sessions.len();\n    let registered_count = workers.len();\n    let total_beads: u64 = workers.iter().map(|w| w.beads_processed).sum();\n\n    // Check heartbeat health for             .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<HeartbeatData>(&s).ok())\n            } else {\n                None\n            };\n\n            let is_alive = is_pid_alive(w.pid);\n
